SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Nat. ar.]
Conjunctivitis after fever has subsided and when case tends to become chronic ; eyes are weak ; symptoms < in morning, as is often the case when eyes are subjected to night work.
Chronic conjunctivitis, membrane injected, small ruga running over it, whole eye dry and painful, all symptoms < in morning ; granular lids from chronic inflammation of edges of lids, with agglutination.
Inner surface of (lower) lids granular.
Lids agglutinated on awaking, morning ; edges chronically inflamed.
Eye symptoms < in morning.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Nat. ar.]
Feels stuffed up, nose and chest.
Nose constantly stopped up, < at night and in morning ; must breathe with mouth open at night.
Nasal discharge yellow, tough ; hawks it or drops from posterior nares.
Pieces of hardened, bluish mucus flow from nose, after which mucous membrane feels raw.
Dry crust in nose, when removed blood flows.
Compressive pain at root of nose and in forehead ; catarrh.
Dull, supraorbital headache ; feeling of fulness of head and face ; eyes heavy and at times soreness of eyeballs ; burning of eyes and more or less congestion of conjunctiva ; watery discharge from one or both nostrils, or stoppage of nose ; dryness of fauces ; dry cough ; < in morning. θ Catarrh.
Pain in forehead and root of nose ; dry, bloody crusts in nose ; dropping of tough mucus from posterior nares ; hawking up of mucus from larynx, < from dust, smoke and cold ; fauces feel dry on inspiration and deglutition. θ Chronic naso-pharyngeal catarrh.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Nat. ar.]
Face flushed and hot ; feels puffed.
Face swollen, œdematous, more in orbital region, < mornings on awaking.
Puffing of face about eyes, glabella and forehead.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Nat. ar.]
Throat œdematous and of a purple color ; tonsils and fauces much pitted ; at bottom of pits portions of diphtheritic formation ; yellow coated tongue ; no appetite ; some obstruction of posterior nares ; nasal sound of voice ; surface of body cool and covered with cold, clammy sweat ; feet cold ; oppression about heart, especially on least exertion ; pulse feeble, quick and intermittent ; wishes to be let alone ; mind without hope. θ Diphtheria.
Tonsils, fauces and pharynx purplish and œdematous, patched with yellow mucus. θ Diphtheria.
After an attack of acute tonsillitis, which occurred three months previously, throat remained very much swollen ; whole of fauces and upper part of pharynx swollen and of a dark red hue ; tonsils greatly enlarged ; uvula elongated ; parts covered with a dirty looking mucus ; constant dry sensation as if something lodged in throat ; at times feeling as if a pin was sticking in throat ; at others a feeling as of a lump, always < in morning.
Dark purplish hue of throat, great swelling and great prostration, but not much pain ; uvula hangs down like a sac of water. θ Diphtheria.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Nat. ar.]
Hematemesis.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Nat. ar.]
Lungs feel as though smoke had been inhaled.
Miner's asthma produced by inhalation of coal dust ; pneumonia and consumption.
   

COUGH. [27] [Nat. ar.]
Dry cough, with feeling of tightness and oppression in middle and upper third of chest.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Nat. ar.]
Dry cough, with an oppressed feeling of chest ; short, dry cough without expectoration ; lungs feel as though smoke had been inhaled ; nose dry and obstructed ; patient feels stuffed up. θ Catarrhal affection.
Woman confined to bed with advanced tuberculosis, hectic, few night sweats, amphoric respiration, emaciation, pulse 128, respirations 40, cough racking, expectoration greenish and profuse ; mental symptoms of bluest remorse.
Hæmoptysis.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Nat. ar.]
Oppression about heart on least exertion. θ Diphtheria.
   

FEVER. [40] [Nat. ar.]
Surface cool, covered with cold, clammy sweat. θ Diphtheria.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Nat. ar.]
Catarrhal troubles of nasal mucous membrane, fauces, trachea and bronchi.
